newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 ends year on bullish note.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 ends year on bullish note.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index ended the year's trading with strong gains powered by major issues SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka.
The PX50 closed 8.8 points, 1.7 percent, higher at 539.6 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares gained 18.1 points, 1.63 percent, to 1,126.1.
Friday's results bring full year 1996 gains on the PX50 index to 27 percent.
SPT Telecom which rose strongly at the fixing dropped back a little during continuous trading but still ended the day up 58 crowns at 3,386.
The bourse's most heavily capitalised banking stock Komercni Banka gained 66 crowns to 2,266.

In the broader market, there were several very heavy gains. Tobacco company Tabak rose 151 crowns to 6,850, computer systems company PVT was up 150 crowns to 4,700 and conference orgainser BVV Brno rose 160 crowns to 3,360.
Activity was extremely light with turnover plunging to just 192 million crowns.
